caption: The video depicts two hands held over a plain white surface, with small metal parts—a thin rod, a cross-shaped bolt-and-nut assembly, and a hex nut—lying scattered in the background throughout. The left hand pinches a ring-shaped object face-on, a light band surrounding a dark center. It rotates the object about a vertical axis until it passes edge-on and settles showing its opposite flat metallic face with a small central hole. Meanwhile the right hand, holding a small cylindrical piece, reorients it so a greyish end faces the disc and translates it leftward and slightly upward. The right hand brings the piece to the disc's central hole, where it seats as a darker circular spot. Both hands converge to hold the combined disc-and-piece, partly occluding the background parts.
relations: Left hand pinching ring face-on -> rotating about vertical axis reveals edge-on then flat opposite face with central hole.
Right hand holding cylindrical piece -> reorienting greyish end toward disc and translating left-up seats it in hole as darker spot.
Background rod, cross bolt-nut, hex nut -> remain scattered as hands converge holding combined disc-and-piece, partly occluding them.
